import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 0x7f7f7f7f;
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class Arc {
        int dest;
        int cap;
        int cost;
        int next;
        
        Arc(int dest, int cap, int cost, int next) {
            this.dest = dest;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.next = next;
        }
    }

    static ArrayList<Arc> arcs;
    static ArrayList<Integer> head;

    static void connect(int u, int v, int capacity, int cost) {
        arcs.add(new Arc(v, capacity, cost, head.get(u)));
        head.set(u, arcs.size() - 1);
        arcs.add(new Arc(u, 0, -cost, head.get(v)));
        head.set(v, arcs.size() - 1);
    }

    static int scanInt() {
        int value = 0;
        int c;
        try {
            c = System.in.read();
            while (c <= ' ') {
                c = System.in.read();
            }
            boolean negative = false;
            if (c == '-') {
                negative = true;
                c = System.in.read();
            }
            while (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                value = value * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = System.in.read();
            }
            if (negative) value = -value;
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
        return value;
    }

    static void output(int value) {
        if (value < 0) {
            System.out.print('-');
            value = -value;
        }
        if (value > 9) output(value / 10);
        System.out.print((char)('0' + (value % 10)));
    }

    static void println(int value) {
        output(value);
        System.out.println();
    }

    static int source, target;
    static ArrayList<Integer> dist, flow, prevNode, prevArc;
    static ArrayList<Boolean> visited;

    static boolean bellman_ford() {
        Arrays.fill(dist.toArray(), INF);
        Arrays.fill(flow.toArray(), 0);
        Arrays.fill(prevNode.toArray(), -1);
        Arrays.fill(prevArc.toArray(), -1);
        Arrays.fill(visited.toArray(), false);
        
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dist.set(source, 0);
        flow.set(source, INF);
        q.add(source);
        visited.set(source, true);
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            visited.set(u, false);
            
            for (int idx = head.get(u); idx != -1; idx = arcs.get(idx).next) {
                int v = arcs.get(idx).dest;
                int cap = arcs.get(idx).cap;
                int cost = arcs.get(idx).cost;
                
                if (cap > 0 && dist.get(v) > dist.get(u) + cost) {
                    dist.set(v, dist.get(u) + cost);
                    flow.set(v, Math.min(flow.get(u), cap));
                    prevNode.set(v, u);
                    prevArc.set(v, idx);
                    if (!visited.get(v)) {
                        q.add(v);
                        visited.set(v, true);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        return prevNode.get(target) != -1;
    }

    static int maxFlow, minCost;

    static void minCostFlow() {
        while (bellman_ford()) {
            int augment = flow.get(target);
            maxFlow += augment;
            minCost += augment * dist.get(target);
            
            int node = target;
            while (node != source) {
                int arcIdx = prevArc.get(node);
                Arc arc = arcs.get(arcIdx);
                Arc revArc = arcs.get(arcIdx ^ 1);
                arcs.get(arcIdx).cap -= augment;
                arcs.get(arcIdx ^ 1).cap += augment;
                node = prevNode.get(node);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = scanInt();
        int m = scanInt();
        int k = scanInt();
        int c = scanInt();
        int d = scanInt();
        
        int B = Math.max(n, k);
        source = n * (2 * B + 1) + 1;
        target = source + 1;
        
        int size = target + 1;
        dist = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(size, 0));
        flow = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(size, 0));
        prevNode = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(size, 0));
        prevArc = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(size, 0));
        visited = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(size, false));
        head = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(size, -1));
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = scanInt();
            connect(source, x, 1, 0);
        }
        
        connect(n * (2 * B) + 1, target, INF, 0);
        
        for (int layer = 0; layer < 2 * B; layer++) {
            connect(layer * n + 1, (layer + 1) * n + 1, INF, 0);
            for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
                connect(layer * n + i, (layer + 1) * n + i, INF, c);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int x = scanInt();
            int y = scanInt();
            for (int layer = 0; layer < 2 * B; layer++) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= k; j++) {
                    int cost = d * (2 * j - 1) + c;
                    connect(layer * n + x, (layer + 1) * n + y, 1, cost);
                    connect(layer * n + y, (layer + 1) * n + x, 1, cost);
                }
            }
        }
        
        minCostFlow();
        println(minCost);
    }
}
